name: Deliver a feature end-to-end
summary: The top-altitude journey of shipping a feature with Leafcutter: you say what you want and the acceptance criteria get authored (plan), the wired ticket is driven through its phase agents until it is green and committed (build), and the PR is merged and the epic/ticket closed (finalize). FIXTURE — bundled mock data for Atlas mock mode.

steps.label: Plan
steps.description: You say what you want and AI agents author the acceptance criteria for it.

steps.label: Build
steps.description: AI phase agents drive the wired ticket through its build phases until it is green and committed.

steps.label: Finalize
steps.description: The finalize pipeline merges the pull request and closes the epic or ticket.

acceptance_scenarios.given: a feature idea described in plain language
acceptance_scenarios.then: the AC store gains Gherkin behaviors for the feature and a ticket is generated ready to build
